subject: POC acceptance tracker & weekly MAP sync
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@edgepay.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgePay Security <security@edgepay.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + POC acceptance criteria (draft)

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the product team at EdgePay is excited to move to a short POC to validate latency and cost under our transaction mix. Attached is a first-pass MAP with suggested milestones and acceptance criteria. High level:

- Objective: end-to-end inference replacement for fraud-score enrichment (90% of current throughput)
- POC length: 3 weeks (test window + acceptance)
- Key acceptance criteria: 95th percentile latency < 200ms (75 token average), accuracy delta <= 1.5% on labeled set, stable KV cache hit > 85%

Blocking items we know of: SOC2 evidence for data handling, a small sample of anonymized transaction logs for tuning, and a clear cutover plan for fallback behavior.

Proposed next steps: quick MAP sync tomorrow to align owners, then 1) get test dataset share 2) finalize infra access 3) start smoke tests.

Attachment: EdgePay-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Would love to lock a 30-min slot. I’m available Mon/Tue mornings PST.

—Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Product, EdgePay

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@edgepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + POC acceptance criteria (draft)

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the clear map.

I’ve booked 30 minutes for Monday 08:30 PT to run through the milestones and owners. Quick confirmations from our side:

- Marissa will own evaluation metrics and the labeled-set scoring pipeline. (Action: Marissa to define the scoring notebook and metric thresholds by Tue EOD)
- Rishi will own infra readiness (access, test harness, latency profiling). (Action: Rishi to share test VM checklist + data ingress plan by Tue EOD)
- I’ll own rollout policy and canary schedule. (Action: Logan to propose canary windows and fallback triggers by Wed)

Notes on attachments: I attached the Redwood MAP template to capture responsibilities (redwood-map-template.xlsx). Sarah — pls confirm the sample dataset cadence and whether security will attach the anonymization checklist.

See you Monday.

Regards,
Logan Wright

On Mon, Jul 26, 2027 at 8:04 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Sarah — appreciate the clear map.

Quick status from infra:
- I’ll spin up a small test cluster (2x A10G equiv) for the smoke + perf runs. Estimated availability: Wed 10:00 PT.
- To validate KV cache behavior we need a representative sequence-length distribution and a minimal sample (<= 2,000 rows) of anonymized transactions with response labels. If possible, please include a short doc describing which fields are sensitive.
- Security ask: SOC2 evidence copy + any ingestion redaction rules. We can start gray-box tests before SOC2 is complete, but production-focused tests that correlate audit logs will require it.

Provisioning checklist attached in-line: VM image, registry access, test harness repo, perf script, ingress credentials. I’ll post the checklist to the MAP sheet once the infra bits are ready.

Blockers right now: dataset share and SOC2 artifact. Otherwise timeline looks feasible for a 3-week POC.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
